propositions: Pass-1 ladder entries are bare Anthropic model names that resolve to provider anthropic regardless of the configured provider, causing split-brain when running with a different provider
Escalation via models_at_or_above() returns bare Anthropic ids that silently resolve to anthropic provider instead of respecting the configured provider
model_ladder[0] is copied directly to cfg.model in three separate batch-runner call sites without class-name resolution
MODEL_LADDER serves dual purposes (escalation order and context-window budget via substring matching) and cannot be changed to class names without breaking window lookups
Reserved class names (trivial, standard, frontier) must be resolved through model_classes.resolve_model_string at multiple independent call sites rather than at a single funnel
config.resolve_model and models_at_or_above must be wired to resolve class names through the class config at runtime, with lazy import in config.py to avoid an import cycle
